Frequently asked questions

Which restaurants accept EBT in Ontario?

Ontario has 62 restaurants authorized for the SNAP Restaurant Meals Program, including Jack in the Box, Carl's Jr., McDonald's, Taco Bell. Each accepts EBT from eligible recipients for prepared meals.

Can anyone use EBT at these Ontario restaurants?

No — only recipients enrolled in the Restaurant Meals Program: those who are 60 or older, have a disability, or are experiencing homelessness (and their spouses). California is a participating state.

What can I buy with EBT at a restaurant in Ontario?

Hot and ready-to-eat meals. Alcohol, tobacco and non-food items aren't covered, and most states don't allow EBT to pay tips. It draws from your regular SNAP balance.

This is a private, independent website for informational purposes only. It is not affiliated with, operated by, or endorsed by the USDA, the Food and Nutrition Administration, or any state agency. Restaurant data comes from the USDA SNAP Retailer Locator and can change — confirm with the restaurant before visiting. We never collect personal information and cannot enroll you in SNAP.
